name: logo-land
description: Logo Land turns a conversation into logo concepts, refinements, and verified PNG packages using native Codex image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Your next logo starts with a conversation.
interface.longDescription: Create eight logo types through a conversation with Codex. Compare concepts, refine a chosen image, remove backgrounds, and export verified PNG files with their history.
defaultPrompt: $logo-land Help me create a logo that fits my brand.
Change only the colors of the selected logo, preserving its shape and lettering.
Resume my saved logo project and export the final PNG.
Create a transparent-background PNG logo. If I provide an existing logo, remove only its background.
